name: @854/best-electrician-jobs
description: A server to find the best electrician jobs in the United States.

PORT.description: The port to run the server on. Defaults to 3000.

HOST.description: The host to run the server on. Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Finds electrician jobs in a given location.

location.description: US city and state, e.g. 'Austin, TX'

examples.title: Find jobs in Austin, TX
examples.description: An example of how to use the `find_jobs` tool to find electrician jobs in Austin, TX.
examples.prompt: Use the find_jobs tool to find electrician jobs in Austin, TX
